description: Free (no credits): put the agent's or agency's mark on listing photos — text (name, phone) and/or the logo saved on their Pixly account — in a corner or the middle, up to 10 photos per call. Returns every marked photo at once. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

photos.description: The photos to mark, 1–10. Each item takes imageUrl or r2Path.

imageUrl.description: Public https URL of the source photo, or a data: URI. Either imageUrl or r2Path is required.

r2Path.description: Storage path of a photo already in the user's Pixly library (from list_library, or returned by an upload ticket) — the alternative to imageUrl.

text.description: The text, e.g. "Smith Realty · 555-0100". Optional when the account has a saved logo.

useLogo.description: Add the logo saved on the account (Pixly floor plan settings), when there is one.

name: watermark_photos

status.description: pending | processing | completed | failed — anything not completed/failed is still running

title: Watermark Photos
